responsibility: Implements GIMPLE switch lowering and switch-conversion optimizations. It analyzes switch statements to replace suitable dense or structured cases with indexed-load/table forms, bit tests, or balanced compare trees, rewrites CFG and PHI structure around the transformed switch, and also provides the more general switch-lowering pass that expands remaining GIMPLE_SWITCH nodes into conditional-branch decision trees for optimized and -O0 pipelines.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the switch-conversion module: it defines the switch_conversion and switch-lowering passes, performs the GIMPLE/CFG rewrites, and emits transformed code. In contrast, tree-switch-conversion.h only declares the cluster classes and support interfaces those passes use.
